description: This PHP source file defines a class 'perf_mssql' for performance monitoring and diagnostics specific to Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL). It includes methods for explaining queries, retrieving table information, and health checks, and contains performance metrics configurations.

classes.name: perf_mssql
classes.description: A class extending 'adodb_perf' providing MSSQL-specific performance monitoring functionalities.

methods.name: perf_mssql
methods.description: Constructor for the 'perf_mssql' class, initializes with a database connection, adjusts properties based on data provider.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL statement, optionally partial based on a checksum.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of tables, their size, index, and reserved space in the database.

methods.name: sp_who
methods.description: Runs the 'sp_who' stored procedure to list current active sessions and returns their count.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the MSSQL instance, enabling and disabling trace flags.
